_comment: Claude Shepherd settings. Copy to ~/.claude/cc-config.json and flip what you want ON. Everything here is OFF by default; nothing auto-acts until you enable it.

routing._comment: 4c-E project routing. With enabled=true AND a project's queue armed (the detail-panel 'route' toggle writes routing:true into its cc-queue file), queued tasks feed WHICHEVER session of that project is free (status done, not stale/error/draining) — not just the one that finished. One feed per project per refresh tick; pops stay delivery-gated; routed feeds are ledgered as by:'router'. starveMinutes>0 flags the project (⌛ + one ledger event) when tasks wait with no free session that long; 0 = off. OFF by default at both levels.

decisions._comment: Per-session gate decision log in the detail panel (last N grouped decisions, e.g. 'deny Bash ×4 (autoDeny: Bash(rm*))'). Pure read of the ledger — hidden when the ledger is off or there are no decisions. limit = max grouped rows shown; hours = lookback window.

notifications._comment: 🔔 notification history ('what fired while you were away'): escalations, stall warnings, auto-respawns, and non-human gate decisions, read from the ledger into the audit overlay's Alerts tab with an unseen-count badge. days = badge/list lookback. Inert while the ledger is off. NOTE: if you set ledger.captureTypes, include 'escalation' and 'hung' or those alerts won't be recorded.

search._comment: 🔎 fleet-wide transcript/ledger search. Uses ripgrep when installed (brew install ripgrep — instant across hundreds of MB), else falls back to grep. rgBin optionally pins an explicit rg path. maxResults caps the rendered hits.

bridge._comment: SSH status bridge (Phase 2). Mirrors each ssh provider's remote ~/.claude/cc-status/ locally via rsync (every intervalSeconds, BatchMode key auth required) so remote sessions render as ⇄ tiles. Remote tiles are HEADLESS-ONLY: Approve/Deny route back over ssh as nonce-bound decision files; keystroke actions are disabled (keystrokes=true is an experimental future unlock — needs hardware verification). staleSlackSeconds widens the staleness threshold for remote tiles (rsync lag + clock skew). Inert unless enabled AND a provider declares ssh:{host,user}. OFF by default.

hung._comment: Stuck-session watchdog (Feature 8). When a session stays 'working' with no transcript growth for `minutes`, flag the tile (⏳ purple ring) and nag once per stall using the same sound/push prefs above. Complements the approval-wait escalation: that fires when a session waits on YOU; this fires when one wedges on its own (an infinite tool loop, a hung command). OFF by default.

ledger._comment: Append-only audit/event ledger of fleet activity, written to ~/.claude/cc-ledger/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl (one JSON event per line). OFF by default — nothing is recorded until enabled. retentionDays: daily files older than this are auto-purged (0 = keep forever). maxTotalMB: cap total ledger size, deleting oldest days first (0 = no cap). captureTypes: empty = record everything; otherwise a list of event types to record (e.g. ["decision","prompt","spawn"]).

focus._comment: Pop/focus the DETECTED editor (VS Code/Cursor; Kitty/terminal left alone) on each event. Legacy popEditor is still honored as a fallback for both.

gate._comment: Headless approvals: arm the gate (Settings toggle) and keep the policies below OFF, then Approve/Deny from the panel with no window pop. tools = space/comma list of tools that wait for you; reads stay instant.

spawn._comment: The + New / New project launcher. editor: terminal | kitty | vscode | cursor. live=false is a dry-run (logs what it would launch, spawns nothing). Kitty/Terminal spawn reliably; VS Code/Cursor open the window then best-effort type `claude` in a new integrated terminal. kittyAutoRemote enables remote control in your kitty.conf when Kitty is in use (so kitty @ effects work). provider = id of a profile in `providers` to launch new sessions against (empty = bare `claude`, default Anthropic). searchRoots/searchDepth/fdBin drive the modal's fuzzy folder search: roots scanned once per modal open (default ~/Programming) to searchDepth, with fd when installed (gitignore-aware) else find. These three survive Settings saves (hand-edit keys).

providers._comment: Each profile launches `claude` against a model. kind=anthropic sets ANTHROPIC_MODEL on the normal endpoint; kind=gateway also sets ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL so Claude Code talks to a LiteLLM-style gateway (Gemini/OpenAI/local) or a local/remote REST server. NO API KEYS HERE: authTokenEnv names an ENV VAR the spawned login shell expands ($NAME) — the key lives in your shell, never in this file. A profile may also carry "ssh": {"host": "devbox", "user": "adam"} to run `claude` on a remote box (the terminal window stays local); pair with the `bridge` block above to see its remote sessions as tiles.
providers.label: Claude Opus 4.8

risk._comment: Per-session risk indicator (Feature E). OFF by default. A small empirical score (0-100) computed from each session's ledger history — deny rate, auto-deny pattern hits, timeout-fallbacks, slow approvals, tool volume — surfaced as a med/high badge on the tile (low shows nothing). Indicator ONLY: it never blocks or quarantines anything. Requires the ledger to be enabled to have data. thresholds.med/high set the band cutoffs; thresholds.staleSeconds is the approval gap that counts as a slow-approval signal. enabled + thresholds are editable in ⚙ Settings; an optional hand-added `weights` map (see RISK_WEIGHTS in cc-core.lua) stays hand-edit-only and survives Settings saves.

collision._comment: Same-directory collision warning (Feature B). OFF by default. Flags tiles when 2+ ACTIVE sessions (working/approval) share a working directory, so two agents editing the same repo don't silently clobber each other. Detection only — it cannot lock another process's writes. useGitRoot groups by git repo root (one cached `git rev-parse` per directory) instead of the exact folder, so sibling subfolders of one repo also count.

drain._comment: Graceful drain (Feature F). OFF by default. Adds a right-click 'Drain (finish turn, then close)' action: instead of closing immediately, it waits for the session to finish the in-flight turn (next done) and then closes. If the session is already idle/done it closes now. Drain wins over queue auto-feed for the same session.

respawn._comment: One-click respawn (Feature F). OFF by default. Adds a right-click 'Respawn from cwd' action that relaunches a dead/stale session from its last working dir + matched provider profile + editor. A gateway session whose provider profile is no longer in `providers` can't be respawned (its auth env can't be reconstructed).

auto._comment: Auto-respawn (opt-in, bounded). Relaunches a session whose status file froze MID-TURN (status 'working' with no hook write for staleSeconds — a crash/kill; a clean exit fires SessionEnd instead). staleSeconds defaults to 600 so a long tool call (Bash timeouts run minutes) never reads as a death; sessions waiting on an APPROVAL are never auto-respawned (stale-approval escalation owns that case). Capped by maxRetries PER LAUNCH FOLDER; the counter resets only after a session in that folder runs healthy for a sustained stretch, so a crash-looping folder can't thrash. Needs a session_id + a respawnable spec (cwd exists, provider known). enabled=false keeps today's manual-only behavior.

insights._comment: Fleet insights view (Feature A) — the 📊 toolbar button. A read-only aggregate of the ledger (turns/session, approval & denial rates, decision provenance, time the fleet spent blocked on you). Always available like the audit view; shows zeros until the ledger is enabled. maxBlockSeconds caps a single request→approval gap when summing 'time blocked on you', so an overnight idle isn't counted.
